entities.name: DL Information Transfer MR-DC Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for downlink information transfer in Multi-RAT Dual Connectivity scenarios where the network sends information to the UE.

entities.name: DLInformationTransferMRDC
entities.description: Message sent from the network to the UE for downlink information transfer in MR-DC scenarios.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that initiates the DL information transfer procedure.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: The User Equipment that receives the DL information transfer message.

relations.description: The DL information transfer procedure includes sending the DLInformationTransferMRDC message.
The network initiates and sends the DLInformationTransferMRDC message.
The DLInformationTransferMRDC message is received by the UE.
